```sql
SELECT ch.effective_month, COUNT(*) AS history_rows
FROM main.country_history ch
WHERE ch.effective_month BETWEEN '2026-10' AND '2027-03'
GROUP BY ch.effective_month
ORDER BY ch.effective_month;
```
